notes.subject: lebelela
notes.rationale: ראה ke 'go bona'; 'go lebelela' go fa maikutlo a go ineela go se nene go feta seo Seheberu se se rego

notes.subject: שמיך/אצבעתיך
notes.rationale: Go segelela ga mmala o motala godimo ga lewatle le mo lewatleng — go bontšha botona bja magodimo kgahlanong le go nyenyana ga motho, go fela ka 'ke eng motho?'

notes.subject: go yena Yahwe
notes.rationale: Sefoko se se bolelela go Yahwe ka boweni — 'magodimo a gago, menwana ya gago'

translation: Ge ke lebelela ⟨את⟩ magodimo a gago, mošomo wa menwana ya gago, kgwedi le dinaledi tše o di theilego
